deadlines.title: Deadlines
deadlines.hint: Deadlines per priority and the reaction deadlines of the escalation. New tickets use the new values; existing tickets keep their stored deadline.
deadlines.sessionNotice: The deadline administration requires a valid sign-in.
deadlines.forbiddenNotice: No permission for the deadline administration.

textTemplates.title: Fault types
textTemplates.hint: The fault types offered by the report form. Archived types still label existing tickets but are no longer offered. Deleting is only possible while no ticket uses the type.
textTemplates.sessionNotice: Fault type administration requires a valid sign-in.
textTemplates.forbiddenNotice: No permission for fault type administration.

errors.session_invalid: Session expired – please sign in again.

errors.text_template_in_use: Tickets still use this fault type, so it cannot be deleted.
errors.text_template_key_taken: A fault type with this key already exists.

bma.title: BMAcloud sync
bma.hint: The object list is pulled read-only from BMAcloud. A sync overwrites name and address of externally maintained objects; notes, contact data and QR codes stay local. Objects missing from the pull are deactivated, never deleted.
bma.sessionNotice: The BMAcloud sync needs a valid sign-in.
bma.forbiddenNotice: No permission for the BMAcloud sync.
bma.noConflicts: The last sync had no conflicts.
bma.scheduleHint: Five fields: minute hour day month weekday. Without a stored value the environment BMA_SYNC_ENABLED / BMA_SYNC_CRON applies.
bma.credentialsHint: The key is only written and never returned. Without a stored value the environment BMA_API_KEY applies.
bma.credentialsSourceDb: The API key is stored in this installation.
bma.credentialsSourceEnv: The API key comes from the environment (BMA_API_KEY).
bma.credentialsSourceNone: No API key is set – the sync cannot run.

errors.session_invalid: Session expired – please sign in again.
errors.invalid_request: Invalid input – please check the cron expression.
errors.bma_not_configured: BMAcloud is not configured – no API key is set. Please enter it in the “BMAcloud API key” field.
errors.bma_bad_response: BMAcloud answered in an unexpected way.

dashboardSettings.title: Dashboard and statistics
dashboardSettings.hint: Wall display, anonymisation and the threshold for conspicuous objects.
dashboardSettings.tvTokenHint: The token protects the wall display. A new token invalidates every open display immediately.
dashboardSettings.rotateConfirm: Rotate the token? Every wall display must be set up again.
dashboardSettings.anonymizeHint: Replaces object names on the wall display with stable pseudonyms.
dashboardSettings.thresholdHint: An object is conspicuous when it has more tickets in the last 90 days than this number.
